description: This file defines a helper class 'DynamoDBMembershipHelper' responsible for parsing a data connection string and populating 'DynamoDBClusteringOptions' with configuration parameters such as Service, TableName, SecretKey, AccessKey, ReadCapacityUnits, and WriteCapacityUnits for DynamoDB clustering in Orleans.

classes.name: DynamoDBMembershipHelper
classes.description: A static helper class that provides parsing functionality for a DynamoDB connection string to set options for Orleans clustering.

methods.name: ParseDataConnectionString
methods.description: Parses a connection string to extract DynamoDB configuration parameters and assigns them to the provided 'DynamoDBClusteringOptions' instance.
